summary: Priority enrichment matrix overwrites route priorities when macro templates apply
description:
Issue summary: After the March 11 macros service deployment (v2.7.0), several internal queues observed incorrect priority assignments. The priority enrichment matrix appears to overwrite explicit route priority fields when a channel macro template is applied.

Impact: Internal routing for support ops and oncall teams is misordering tickets; P1 tickets occasionally landing in lower-priority inboxes and missing SLA-driven escalation. This impacts internal SLAs and delays investigation for critical incidents.

Observed behavior: When a 'high-urgency' channel macro is attached to an incoming ticket, the enrichment pipeline applies matrix rules and sets priority to P3 in routing metadata, even though the route definition had priority=P1. The console view shows the route priority still as P1 but the routing decision uses the enriched value (P3).

Expected behavior: Enrichment should only add missing priority or append a suggested_priority field; it should not override explicit route.priority. Routing engine should prefer route config over enrichment unless a flag explicitly allows overwrite.

Steps to reproduce: 1) Create a synthetic ticket via internal webhook with route_id=ops-oncall and priority=P1. 2) Attach macro template channel: "high-urgency:notify-escalation". 3) Observe enrichment logs in macros-service: enrichment.applied -> priority=3. 4) Inspect routing decision in rule-evaluator: selected_queue uses priority=3. 5) Confirm ticket lands in ops-inbox (P3 queue).

Logs & artifacts: See macros-service logs (mar-11 21:10 UTC) at /var/log/macros/macros-2026-03-11.log and rule-evaluator trace id re-0a3b6f. Example log snippets included in investigation notes.

Immediate mitigation: Rollback macros-service to v2.6.4 or patch enrichment pipeline to set enrichment.suggested_priority instead of priority. Mitigation applied: temporary feature-flag enabled to skip priority enrichment for routes with explicit priority on 2026-03-12 03:45 UTC.
steps_to_reproduce: POST synthetic ticket to /internal/v1/tickets with route_id=ops-oncall and priority=P1
Attach macro template header X-Macro-Template: high-urgency:notify-escalation
Stream logs from macros-service and filter enrichment.applied events
Check rule-evaluator trace for selected_queue and resulting priority metadata
observed_behavior: Enrichment pipeline sets priority=P3 when macro is applied
Routing engine uses enrichment.priority over route config
Console shows route priority=P1 but ticket delivered to lower-priority queue
expected_behavior: Enrichment should not overwrite explicit route.priority
Routing should prefer configured route.priority unless overwrite is enabled
SLAs should trigger escalation based on configured priority
investigation_notes: 2026-03-11 21:12 UTC: Initial alert from #internal-support that two P1 tickets missed oncall alerting
SRE (M. Li) pulled re-0a3b6f trace; rule-evaluator shows priority metadata = 3 pre-route-selection
macros-service v2.7.0 introduced 'priority enrichment matrix' feature to normalize priorities across channels
Config review: enrichment matrix file matrix-priority.yaml contains mapping with higher precedence than 'preserve_existing' flag was set to false by default
Hypothesis: New code path applies enrichment and writes to ticket.priority instead of ticket.suggested_priority, then rule-evaluator does not check 'is_source_explicit'
Replication: Replayed synthetic payload in staging reproduced the overwrite within 5 runs consistently
Related telemetry: sla-monitor shows 18 internal SLA misses between 2026-03-11 21:00 and 2026-03-12 04:00 in us-east
comments: Evan Patel (Reporter) - 2026-03-12: Noticed pattern after deploy; opened ticket and flagged as P1. Added preliminary logs.
Marcus Li (SRE) - 2026-03-12: Pulled traces and confirmed enrichment writes priority field. Tentatively toggled FF:macros.priority_preserve to true in prod to reduce impact.
Roxanne Torres (Routing Eng) - 2026-03-12: I'm owning the follow-up. Will instrument rule-evaluator to log priority.source and priority.overwritten booleans. Assigning to myself.
Priya Meng (Support Ops) - 2026-03-12: Confirmed rollback of v2.7.0 to v2.6.4 reduces SLA misses in sampled windows. Keep us posted on root cause.
Roxanne Torres (Routing Eng) - 2026-03-13: Added a hotfix to macros-service to write suggested_priority. Deploying patch to canary now. Will monitor for 1 hour then promote.

Roxanne Torres (Routing Eng) - 2026-03-14: Canary stable, promoting to prod at 10:30 UTC. Post-deploy telemetry shows priority.source=route for sampled tickets. Marking In Progress until full sweep validated.
temporary_workarounds: Enabled feature flag FF:macros.priority_preserve=true in prod (2026-03-12 03:45 UTC)
Rolled back macros-service from v2.7.0 to v2.6.4 in one cluster (canary) for comparison
Support ops manually escalated affected tickets and added a post-it style marker to identify impacted cases
resolution_notes: 2026-03-13: Hotfix merged to ensure enrichment writes suggested_priority instead of overwriting ticket.priority (PR #198).
2026-03-13 11:20 UTC: Canary deployment completed without priority regressions for 1200 synthetic runs.
2026-03-14 10:30 UTC: Production rollout completed. Enabled stricter validation in rule-evaluator to prefer explicit route.priority unless enrichment.overwrite flag true.
Follow-ups: Create a post-deploy test harness that runs synthetic tickets with macro templates against routing to catch regressions (ACTION: INT-24702).
Owners: Roxanne Torres - routing enforcement changes, Marcus Li - monitoring alerts, Evan Patel - post-deploy verification checklist.
next_steps: INT-24702: Implement automated e2e gating tests for macros + routing
Audit enrichment matrices to add explicit precedence annotations and add CI linting
Update runbook: add step to verify priority.source in rule-evaluator after macros deploys
Schedule retrospective with macros-service, routing, and support-ops to align on template semantics
